distribution_model.detail: Owns, leases and manages golf courses and operates its own Drive Shack and Puttery venues.

market_position.detail: Elevated, premium hospitality at Puttery and Drive Shack, plus municipal, daily fee and private courses.

notes: Market position is a judgment, since courses span municipal to private.

product_category.detail: Golf course play, hitting bays, mini golf and on-site food and beverage.

purchase_frequency.detail: Leisure golf rounds, social outings and corporate events.

sub_sector.value: golf course management; golf entertainment venues; social mini golf
